persona: HRIS analyst who runs Workday reports and EIB loads
resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
HRIS Analyst, Indrayani Global Services, Pune (2021 - present)
- Load new hires and job changes into Workday with EIB templates every month.
- Built 35 Workday custom reports with calculated fields for HR business partners.
- Updated business process steps and security groups for the hire and termination flows.
- Gathered requirements from the payroll team for a new monthly headcount file.
- Tested Workday release changes in the sandbox tenant before production.
- Presented monthly HR data quality findings to HR leadership.

HR Operations Associate, Sinhagad Business Solutions, Pune (2019 - 2021)
- Kept employee records and joining data in Excel trackers.

SKILLS
Workday HCM, EIB, Excel, XML

EDUCATION
BBA, Symbiosis, 2019
